items.title: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting
items.description: The suspect was shot dead by a community member who followed him into the Oregon school, police said.

items.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded

items.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad

items.title: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York

items.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
